original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. Using the warm fixturenet base snapshot, stack/scripts/armada-disclosure-acceptance.py runs hops H1-H7 of docs/tasks/16-selective-disclosure.md as real transactions: H1 a test EOA shields USDC; H2 and H4 the note funds a hub channel through depositFromNote; H7 the wallet and the hub co-sign channel states; H5 the channel pays a SHIELD payout to a fresh note of the same wallet; H6 that note is unshielded to a second test EOA. It records every transaction and event into a disclosure package file, then tears the fixturenet down.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. The harness stands up the fixturenet but does not run the hops or record a package.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. Run the compose job on the warm snapshot. The script prints one JSON line with the fields hops_ok true (H1, H2, H4, H5, H6 and H7 each succeeded), eoa2_usdc_delta a positive integer, eoa_distinct true, payout_note_owned true, and package_path the written package.
restatement: The script stack/scripts/armada-disclosure-acceptance.py must run hops H1-H7 of docs/tasks/16-selective-disclosure.md as real transactions on the warm fixturenet base snapshot. H1: a test EOA shields USDC. H2 and H4: the note funds a hub channel through depositFromNote. H7: the wallet and the hub co-sign channel states. H5: the channel pays a SHIELD payout to a fresh note of the same wallet. H6: that note is unshielded to a second test EOA. The script records every transaction and event into a disclosure package file, then tears the fixturenet down. Run as a compose job, it prints one JSON line with hops_ok true, eoa2_usdc_delta a positive integer, eoa_distinct true, payout_note_owned true, and package_path set to the written package.

restatement_clauses.text: hops_ok is true, meaning H1, H2, H4, H5, H6 and H7 each succeeded as real transactions.
eoa2_usdc_delta is a positive integer: the second test EOA gained USDC from the unshield in H6.
eoa_distinct is true: the first and second test EOAs are different accounts.
payout_note_owned is true: the H5 SHIELD payout note belongs to the same wallet.
package_path names the written disclosure package file that records every transaction and event.
The script tears the fixturenet down after it records the package.

goal: The disclosure acceptance script runs all hops on the fixturenet, writes a disclosure package, and reports success in one JSON line.
acceptance_criteria: Running the acceptance script prints a JSON line that says all hops H1, H2, H4, H5, H6 and H7 succeeded.
The printed line shows the second test account gained a positive amount of USDC.
The printed line says the two test accounts are different.
The printed line says the payout note belongs to the same wallet.
The printed line gives a non-empty path for the disclosure package file.
The script text contains a step that shuts the fixturenet down.
